dedupe_keys.name: nursing home ownership crosswalk 2 192 certified facilities in california florida washington and arizona resolved to controlling owners

description: This dataset links every Medicare- or Medicaid-certified nursing home in four US states to the party that ultimately controls it. It was built by Ashwin Joshi of the University of California, Berkeley, and published on Dryad in August 2026. Federal disclosure of owners often stops at a single-purpose company holding one building, so the author traced ownership through sources that are free to access and attached 11,995 public source citations row by row. The frame is the full population of 2,192 facilities in the CMS nursing home provider file snapshot of 27 May 2026: 1,164 in California, 694 in Florida, 194 in Washington and 140 in Arizona, of which 2,061 are dually certified, 103 Medicare-only and 28 Medicaid-only. Of these, 2,181 were resolved to 759 distinct controlling owners. The files, about 9 MB, are free to download from Dryad under a Creative Commons Zero public domain dedication. Caveats: ownership changes often, so the crosswalk reflects mid-2026, and resolution relies on public records that may be incomplete. Simulation uses: grouping facilities by operator for evacuation, surge and supply planning where one owner's decisions affect many homes. Related records: the CMS hospitals catalogue (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) and the weekly nursing home bed census (data-nursing-home-weekly-bed-census-last-submission-p02651) supply other facility attributes.
